note: Files: B = studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (t1_right, t1_cap_hit), text/gold = first row per problem_index of s3 r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl; O = first row per problem_index of iterate-runs:abaybektursun-1114-152855-683b/answers.jsonl (score_v3; cap hit = cap_hit true, or missing and finish_reason 'length'); E = first sample==0 row of s3 r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl and first row of s3 r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl, regraded with rln4_lib.grade_v3(row gold, row text), right iff score_v3 == 1 and not a cap hit. All fetched into runs/theory-tests/duel-r7-account/. B right = t1_right == 1 and t1_cap_hit not true; gap = O right and B wrong; problems missing on either side or with null t1_right/score_v3 excluded. Rule A: windows of 8,000 characters starting at position 0 or after each '\n' with >= 8,000 characters left, UTF-8 zlib default level ratio < 0.10. R3: N deletes all regex \s whitespace, then '$', '*', '#', '\left', '\right' (literal, so '\rightarrow' loses '\right'), then \dfrac/\tfrac -> \frac; lines of B's T1 text (which starts with the cue continuation ' line!') split on '\n'; missing T1 row/text taken. An E row with null text is graded on '' (wrong); a null gold counts wrong. Bootstrap resamples the gap problems (n = number of gap problems). If there are no gap problems the script prints not_computable. Alt reading (alt_measured): kB counts E rows whose v3 regrade is right without forcing cap hits to wrong (the recipe's 'v3 regrade' definition taken alone). refuted_by is null so refuted_by_met is always false.

Same code, files and conventions as p1 (B per_problem.json + T1.jsonl text/gold; O = 683b theta0.5 cue answers.jsonl, score_v3; E = base-01 P_math500 sample 0 + modal_t3-01 T3, grader v3 regrade, right = v3 right and not cap hit); statistic = share of gap problems whose first-taking rule is R5 deliberation (E non-empty and kB == 0). Because R3 precedes R4/R5 and takes any gap problem whose B text has no box and no 'Answer:' line or states the gold, the deliberation share depends heavily on R3's literal string matching (e.g. a box with equivalent but differently written gold such as '\frac12' vs '\frac{1}{2}' is not taken by R3). Alt reading: kB from v3 regrade ignoring the cap-hit rule. No gap problems -> not_computable. refuted_by null -> false.
